stories.headline: Petit Paris plans a smaller restart while protecting its wood supply
stories.body: Le Réveil reports that the Petit Paris sawmill in Saint-Ludger-de-Milot plans to restart part of its production in mid-October with about 20 employees, compared with roughly 80 before its 2024 shutdown. The original report was published…

stories.headline: Atlas completes commissioning; production performance is the next test
stories.body: Atlas Engineered Products announced October 8 that commissioning is complete at its new 42,000-square-foot facility in Clinton, Ontario. Training and testing are underway on sellable roof-truss production runs. The company describes the…

stories.headline: BLM reports timber sold, with another October offering plan
stories.body: BLM’s October 7 quarterly release reports $29.8 million in timber-sale revenue and about 121 million board feet sold across 5,300 acres during July–September 2026 in Oregon, Washington, Wyoming and Idaho. The agency also describes plans for…

stories.headline: Iron County’s thirteen timber tracts close October 15 at 8:30 a.m.
stories.body: Iron County’s Fall 2026 prospectus accepts sealed bids for thirteen timber tracts until October 15 at 8:30 a.m. Hurley time, with opening at 9 a.m. Bids must reach the Forestry Department Office at 607 Third Avenue North, Suite 2, Hurley.…
